hardening.minimized_reason: Build Samba without PAM: no pam_winbind module, and no Samba library depends on libpam.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; the Werewolf samba form confines smbd.

changes.what: Configure --without-pam, drop linux-pam-dev, and remove the samba-pam-winbind subpackage.
changes.why: libauth-samba, which the server needs, linked libpam, bringing pam_unix and its unix_chkpwd helper into the file server's image. Werewolf's Samba authenticates users against its own password database, never through PAM.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi ships a Samba whose server and libraries do not depend on libpam; review before retiring this overlay.
